faqs.q: What makes NextGen Scholars different from traditional coding bootcamps?
faqs.a: NextGen Scholars focuses on grooming practical, high-impact skills required in modern engineering teams. Rather than passive lectures, every learner builds production-grade software, receives direct feedback from senior industry engineers, and contributes actively to real-world tech solutions.

faqs.q: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faqs.a: Yes. Our AI Engineering & Generative AI program starts with Python for AI Engineering, ensuring learners have the required programming and API fundamentals before advancing to machine learning, LLMs, and RAG architectures.

faqs.q: What does 'Learn today • Lead tomorrow' mean in practice?
faqs.a: It represents our core philosophy: gaining master-level technical mastery today so you can lead tech initiatives, launch products, architect robust systems, and mentor others tomorrow.

faqs.q: Do students work on real-world projects?
faqs.a: Yes. 100% of the curriculum revolves around building, reviewing, deploying, and maintaining real software. You will complete your course with a public, battle-tested portfolio.
